```{r,echo=FALSE}
# sqrt(ax) = b

while(T){
    b = sample(2:12,1)
    a = sample(2:6,1)*sample(c(-1,1),1)
    x = b^2/a
    if(x%%1==0 && abs(a)!=abs(b)){break}
}

eq = paste0("\\sqrt{",a,"x}=",b)
eq2 = paste0(a,"{x}=",b^2)

eq3 = paste0("\\sqrt{",a,"\\cdot(",x,")}\\stackrel{?}{=}",b)
eq3 = gsub("+-","-",eq3,fixed=T)

eq4 = paste0("\\sqrt{",a*x,"}\\stackrel{?}{=}",b)
eq4 = gsub("+-","-",eq4,fixed=T)

```

Question
========

Find the value of $x$ that satisfies the equation.

$$`r eq`$$

Solution
========

Square both sides.

$$`r eq2`$$

Divide both sides by `r a`.

$$x=`r x`$$

Check the solution in the original equation.

$$`r eq3`$$

$$`r eq4`$$

Yup, that is true. So $x=`r x`$ is a solution to the given equation.
